maria ramos: opened a quick PR to fix SDK snippets in the Optimize Toolkit docs. Go example used outdated API and a dead external link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612

joel tan: thanks. i'll update the Go snippet to use ContinuousBatcher and switch the external gist to /examples/optimize/sdk_go/kv_prefetch/main.go

sophia li: small UX ask: add a one-line note that KV prefetch is optional and a 2-row mini table showing tokens/sec improvement. keeps expectations clear.

joel tan: will do. adding runnable cmd: `go run ./examples/optimize/sdk_go/kv_prefetch --profile shortseq`

maria ramos: also please add fallback note: "If prefetch misses, requests fall back to single-request path with higher p95."
